cores.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production Minecraft legendary magic CORE item icon, intended for 128x128 RGBA pixel-art export.
Image1: matching finished wand sprite, exact palette, materials and theme reference. Image2: existing Chronos magic core sprite, exact size, centered medallion composition and pixel-art family reference.
Create ONLY ONE isolated core gemstone relic, NOT a wand and no handle. It must belong to the wand in image1 and look exquisitely crafted, worthy of mythic rarity. Round or faceted compact symmetrical heraldic jewel, ornate polished gold / silver framework, deliberate faceted gemstone shading and small readable inlaid motifs. Crisp deliberate logical128x128 square pixels, clean hard outlines and brilliant highlight pixels, same visual weight and item texture style as existing core in image2. Not a smooth painting or 3D render.
Square canvas, icon centered with at least12% empty transparent padding on all edges; whole jewel fits inside ~74%canvas. Compact silhouette fills40%-45%of canvas; rich inner detail remains readable at small scale. True RGBA transparency, including gaps between ornaments. No background, checkerboard, floor, shadows, translucent aura, detached particles, captions, lettering, numbers, watermarks or extra objects. Shine remains INSIDE the jewel.
Subject: Core of the Verdant Crown. A luminous faceted EMERALD DRAGON HEART in a luxurious antique golden circular crown bezel, bright mint-green central gem, layered dark jade green sides, elegant symmetrical dragon-horn gold prongs curling around the gem like a crown, small gold leaf-like engravings built into the frame and a small angular emerald accent at the bottom. Dominant emerald, jade, warm gold and small ivory highlights. Carry the unmistakable green crystal dragon crown theme of the matching wand. Keep compact medallion body, not a spiky staff head.
